newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico loses 580,000 hectares lumber land per year.
newsitem.headline: Mexico loses 580,000 hectares lumber land per year.

text.p: Mexico loses around 580,000 hectares of lumber forest lands per year, the state news agency Notimex said Tuesday.

Citing Jaime Rodriguez Lopez, the Michoacan state Farm development and Forestry Minister, Notimex said around 700,000 hectares of forests are damaged every year and only around 120,000 are recovered and reforested.
Rodriguez Lopez said the lumber land losses come mainly from changes of land use to illegal lumbering.
He said in the state of Michoacan alone forest losses run at 30,000 hectares per year. Around 27 percent of the state's surface area of six million hectares are under forest.
